cases.title: A selectable alternative name must not invalidate later fields of an ID-less place
Cancellation acknowledged before a pending compatibility submission enters commit must prevent formal writes
Cancelling a retryable failed promotion must persist and return cancelled
Reading an active analysis from another service must not declare it interrupted
A stale snapshot cannot replace cancelled or manufacture a commit decision
All direct compatibility mutation APIs respect the same cancellation
Concurrent adoption of a legacy staging project returns one run identity
A real dead analysis owner is recovered explicitly with a new generation
A legacy irreversible promotion decision wins over its contradictory old cancelled run
A failed authority revision save rolls back the unacknowledged merge choice
A failed authority save rolls back reviewed domain bytes and the review terminal
Unregistered promotion recovery cannot adopt files absent from its manifest
The run decision recovers even when the physical checkpoint was not advanced
A dead source owner resumes its saved preview and metadata before staging exists
A legacy committed merge is adopted from its verified file-transaction receipt
A failed parsed source with no local worker claims a fresh token and stages its saved request
Candidate defaults and omissions are not authorization to erase existing facts
